site_2_bounty_issues.why_hits_are_not_duplicates: all four lexical hits are reviews of other plugins (dsh-myskin, Fly Skins, dsh-fish, dsh-ppt); none names BeiZi6/dsh-theme-plugin, its author, or its preset/Theme Studio scope

conclusion: Both required sites were checked (review site: all 8 review pages / 147 reviews; bounty repo: 3 lexical queries incl. exact package name and author). No same-scope duplicate of BeiZi6/dsh-theme-plugin 0.1.0 was found, so this review can be labelled 首报 within those two sites only. This is not a claim about any other site.
limitations: review-site plugin registry cannot be text-searched through its public API (q parameter ignored); duplicate judgement therefore rests on scanning all published review titles plus the site search page captured in discovery/
bounty search covers issues only (the repo has no other content type relevant to a first-report claim)
